Misdreavus

Ghost

Johto · Generation 2

Misdreavus is a Ghost-type Screech Pokémon first found in Johto (Generation 2). It stands 0.7 m tall and weighs 1 kg. It evolves into Mismagius. Its highest base stat is Sp. Atk (85), with a base stat total of 435.
